card.name: Colon between Bible chapter and verse
card.fires_on: The colon that separates chapter from verse in a Bible reference, right after a book name and chapter number, such as "Job 28:25".

modes.label: Chapter-verse colon
modes.description: The colon after a chapter number in a scripture citation, often in parentheses.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens, which are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the colon in a Bible citation that comes just before the verse number.
